$comment: Plan-tracker structural registry TEMPLATE — copy to plan-<planId>.json in this folder (the id in the file name must match planId below) and fill in for YOUR ADO test plan. Structure only: branches (inScope flag), suites (branch = index into branches[]), cases with consolidation verdict (k=keep, d=drop-duplicate, f=fold-into-e2e, t=trivial) and review note, non-automatable rulings (manual map: caseId -> reason), and the filed-bugs registry (bugs map: bugId -> {sev, title, url, cases}). Progress/status does NOT live here — it lives in history.jsonl next to this file (append-only dated events). Rendered by scripts/generate-tracker.mjs.
names: <owner display name — assign events reference these>

branches.name: <a branch ruled out of automation scope>

cases.title: <test case title as it reads in ADO>
cases.desc: <one-line behavior summary from the consolidation review>
